description: Allows staff to retrieve legal deposit records for a given date range.
instructions:
Enter the start date and the end date in the form d/mm/yyyy for LD records received within that date range. Only records with the following expense classes on their purchase orders are retrieved: AUSMUS/LD,
AUSMON/GD,
AUSMON/LD,
AUSMAPFRE/ATLD,
AUSMAPFRE/ATGD,
AUSMAPFRE/LD,
AUSMAPFRE/GD.
